name: Chandresh
description: Chandresh lives in Mumbai and spends his time reading, walking, drinking chai, and watching F1. He has spent last 6 years building end-to-end marketing functions for blockchains projects like Gnosis, Circles, IDRISS, and Shardeum. He is the core organiser of ETHMumbai, which has now hosted 20 meetups, 2 hackathons, and a conference in Mumbai, since 2023.
